decisions.reason: As an incremental service close to existing offers, it likely meets aspirations and can be carried with organizational slack.
Although operationally demanding, no shortfall is reported and the 72-hour promise remains a competitive service extension.
The certified fire door is a core, home-page-highlighted product that aligns with the firm's safety reputation and meets aspirations.
The express delivery program is presented on its own page and complements established distribution, so slack supports keeping it.
The digital platform is more uncertain but fits the firm's service direction and can be retained with organizational slack while results develop.
The fire and smoke protection door is close to the established range and is kept due to likely satisfactory results.
